_note: Folder-owned PUBLIC MIRROR declaration for the Despia MCP package (ClosedSource/scripts/mirror_public.rb; OpenSource/Engine/mirror.json documents the schema). Same laws as the two mirrors next door: the monorepo is the source of truth, the mirror root is the package root so Package.swift resolves for SPM, the `check` is Linux-only with no Swift step (the mirror lane is not pinned to a mac), and `tag_from` is the bare VERSION file. `vendor` grafts only the mcp slice of the AI corpus in at conformance/mcp, which is why that corpus was subfoldered on day one (P·b). EVERY include path must be git-TRACKED when the lane runs: the mirror lane works from a fresh clone, git does not track empty folders, and a missing include path is a hard abort. The Swift package is proven separately by the mac readiness lane; this Linux mirror gate covers anatomy, the standalone TypeScript corpus, and Kotlin/JVM tests.
